payload.title: Document public site forms on the Papyrus marketing site
payload.description: When PPY-caf9be (public site forms into newsroom Messages) ships, add it to the features list on the Papyrus marketing site (AnthusAI/Papyrus-web, private; content/index.md, or the features page created by the marketing features-list task): what it does (contact and call-to-action forms on the public site land in newsroom Messages, triaged by editors and agents; a built-in alternative to a CRM), spam protection, privacy handling, and how a site enables a form.
